title: code_block_size exempts a mermaid fence at every level
description: code_block_size exempts a mermaid code fence from maxCodeLines at every level, including the Beginner cap of 0, per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 4. total_length already excludes code, so a diagram adds no words.

acceptanceCriteria.text: code_block_size ignores mermaid fences when counting code lines, at every level including Beginner
A non-mermaid code block is still counted and still fails where the cap is 0
total_length still excludes code, so a diagram adds no words

finalSummary:
code_block_size exempts a mermaid fence from maxCodeLines at every level, including Beginner cap 0. A Mermaid diagram is the operator-questions skill required drawing, not the code a level forbids, so it is not counted; any other fence, named or bare, still is. codeBlocks now returns {lang, lines} so the check reads the fence language from the one parser rather than a second one. total_length is unchanged (stripCode already excludes every fence), so a diagram adds no words.

Proved both ways: a mermaid fence alone scores 1 at Beginner cap 0 and at Advanced cap 10 even when 30 lines; a js fence still scores 0 at Beginner; a mixed reply with a mermaid fence and a js fence still scores 0 naming 1 code block; a mermaid fence adds no words to total_length. Mutated the exemption (filter disabled) and confirmed exactly the predicted subset went red: 2 failed, 250 passed, then restored and re-verified.

Gates: npm --prefix harness test 252 pass / 0 fail (was 249); node src/cli.mjs audit exit 0, all 12 checks agree; claude plugin test 21/21; claude plugin validate exit 0.
